season-1.alt: The Brook Road Builders gather in front of a yellow excavator and a blue Pine Park fence.

season-2.alt: The builders stand beside a wooden bridge, with a yellow truck and a red barn in the distance.

season-3.alt: The builders visit a farm with a tractor, hay bales, and a red barn.

season-4.path: brook-road-builders/Season 004 - The Garage with the Red Door.png
season-4.alt: The builders meet a mechanic outside a red-door garage.

season-5.alt: A delivery worker unloads parcels from a blue van while the builders gather nearby.

season-6.alt: The builders watch from indoors as a green truck pumps water from a flooded street.

season-7.alt: The builders meet a firefighter in front of a fire engine and station.

season-8.alt: The builders watch an orange plow clear a snowy road.

season-9.path: brook-road-builders/Season 009 - Where the Gravel Comes From.png
season-9.alt: The builders visit a gravel plant with conveyors and a yellow loader.

season-10.alt: The builders gather around the barn while a loader holds timber overhead.

season-11.alt: The builders stand beside a finished road that curves toward the sunrise.

season-12.path: brook-road-builders/Season 012 - The Road to Star Harbor.png
season-12.alt: The builders gather beside a crane and a launch tower under construction.

season-13.path: brook-road-builders/Season 013 - The Rocket and the Rover.png
season-13.alt: The builders wear space suits in front of a rocket, with a rover nearby.

season-14.path: brook-road-builders/Season 014 - The Moon and the Way Home 2.png
season-14.alt: The builders pose beside a lunar lander and rover, with Earth visible above the Moon.

season-15.path: brook-road-builders/Season 015 - Five Candles and Four Wheels 2.png
season-15.alt: The builders gather around a red wagon carrying a birthday cake and gifts.
